-- t/Helpers.java --
package demo;
public final class Helpers {
  public static long floor1(long x) { return Math.max(x, 1L); }
  static final long fl2(long y)
  {
    if (y >= 1 ) return y;
    return 5;
  }
  public static long bad(long x) {
    return x;
  }
  static long ternary(long z) {
    return z < 1L ? 1 : z;
  }
  static long ret1(long z) {
    if (z == 0) {
      return 1L;
    }
    return z;
  }
}
-- t/Use.java --
package demo;
import javax.baja.sys.*;
class Use extends BComponent {
  void a(long x, long y) {
    Clock.schedule(this, BRelTime.make(Helpers.floor1(x)), go, null);
    Clock.schedule(this, BRelTime.make(bad(x)), go, null);
    Clock.schedule(this, BRelTime.make(fl2(y)), go, null);
    long d = Helpers.floor1(x);
    Clock.schedule(this, BRelTime.make(d), go, null);
    long d2 = bad(x);
    Clock.schedule(this, BRelTime.make(d2), go, null);
    if (bad(x) > 0) {
      Clock.schedule(this, BRelTime.make(bad(x)), go, null);
    }
    Clock.schedulePeriodically(this, BRelTime.make(Helpers.ternary(x)), go, null);
    Clock.schedule(this, BRelTime.make(Other.ret1(x)), go, null);
    Clock.schedule(this, BRelTime.make(  unknownFn (x)), go, null);
    long d3 = Other.unknown(x);
    Clock.schedule(this, BRelTime.make(d3), go, null);
  }
}
